name: Still Believing
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent!  I can't wait to read these. Please do keep bringing the encrypted texts here if you find them.
narrative.requestItemsText: Find any more encrypted texts? Bring me a good batch of them, this decoding work takes some time.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 58 to 60, 25,700 XP in all.

quests.name: The Twilight Mystery
quests.objectiveText: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.

quests.name: The Deserter
quests.objectiveText: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

quests.name: The Twilight Lexicon
quests.objectiveText: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

quests.name: True Believers
quests.objectiveText: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts
